bank.solutions: Kaggle solutions copies beside the pools

note_n_boot: compare() called with 50 task resamples (cluster_bootstrap divides by n_boot); the bootstrap does not enter the gates and is not kept per seed
net_needed_definition: smallest integer T with P(net >= T) <= alpha over the seeds

null_pair.description: Two distinct candidates drawn at random from the pool (B0's attempts when the pool is empty).

null_rerank.description: A random permutation of the kgmon ranking; its top two.

null_jitter.description: kgmon scores jittered by Gaussian noise (sigma 0.5 in score units, the size of a typical margin); top two

null_jitter1.description: kgmon scores jittered with sigma 1.0 (see null_jitter).

null_jitter2.description: kgmon scores jittered with sigma 2.0 (see null_jitter).

null_q27swap.description: v7's merge with the 27B samples in random order (which differing sample fills attempt_2 is chance).
